tests.goal: Confirm that a user can flip between regenerated replies

steps.action: Regenerate a reply at least twice.
Use the branch arrows on the message.
acceptanceCriteria: You can flip between each regenerated reply
Each reply shows its own content

tests.goal: Confirm that branches survive leaving and returning to a chat

steps.action: Create a few forks in a long conversation.
Open another chat, then come back.
acceptanceCriteria: All branches are still present and navigable

tests.goal: Confirm that a user can keep chatting after an error

steps.action: Trigger an error reply (e.g. briefly disconnect the network mid-send)
acceptanceCriteria: If you refresh, you can continue this chat
